buy.q: How do I buy a product?
buy.a: Open the product page, tap Buy, then confirm the payment with your DSI balance. You get access as soon as the payment is confirmed.

recharge.q: How do I see or top up my DSI balance?
recharge.a: Your balance is shown and topped up in your DSI space, from the member space.

pending.q: My payment is “in progress”, what should I do?
pending.a: Wait a few seconds, then tap “Check my payment” in My purchases. Confirmation usually arrives very quickly.

access.q: Where do I find my purchases?
access.a: In the My purchases tab. Tap “Access my purchase” to open the product, as often as you like.

twice.q: Can I buy the same product twice?
twice.a: Yes. Each purchase is independent and charged separately: check My purchases before buying a product again.
